faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Research Associate position at IIT Delhi is 27 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline to be considered for the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Research Associate post in the IIT Delhi recruitment drive. Interested candidates should review the official notification for detailed information regarding this single contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Delhi Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Delhi Research Associate recruitment is via Email. Candidates need to prepare their application with all required documents and send it to the official email address specified in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate position at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selected Research Associate will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000/- per month, along with HRA @ 27%. This competitive remuneration package is offered for the contractual position at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. or a 1st class M.Tech. with 3 years of research experience in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. A minimum of 3 high-quality first author research papers on OPV is also essential.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Delhi Research Associate recruitment. Candidates can apply without any financial cost, making it accessible for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Research Associate at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position at IIT Delhi involves two main stages: initial shortlisting of applications based on eligibility criteria, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates to assess their suitability.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Associate position is New Delhi, Delhi, with pincode 110016. The work will be carried out at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi campus, offering a vibrant research environment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Delhi's research and development unit, where relevant information and notifications are often published, is http://ird.iitd.ac.in. Candidates are advised to visit this site for updates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for the Research Associate position. However, a 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates in the selection process.
